1. Aadhaar Verhoeff Checksum: Dihedral Group D5 Multiplication Table
2. Passport ICAO 9303 Checksum: Weighting factors [7, 3, 1] Modulo 10
3. Driving Licence Format: State prefix + RTO code + year format validation
4. Date Consistency: DOB in past, expiry date in future, issue vs DOB checks
CheckItem Output: { check: string, label: string, passed: boolean, detail: string }
Disclaimer: Structural validity does not guarantee document authenticity.
Load-bearing signal for officer decision support.
Algorithm: Error Level Analysis via Canvas Recompression
1. Resaves canvas image at 75% JPEG quality
2. Computes per-pixel absolute error diff: |Orig - Recompressed|
3. Calculates Mean Error, Outlier Ratio (>35 diff), and Edge Concentration
Generates base64 visual error heatmap canvas data URL
Method: MobileNet Feature Embeddings + Cosine Distance
1. Detects face bounding box on document scan and live selfie
Fallback: Isolated try-catch returns no_face without blocking screening pass.
• Failed Checksum Item: +25 points per failure
• ELA Tamper High (>=45): +35 points | Suspicious (25-44): +15 points

1. Queries Local Ledger for sessions where (decision != null && synced == false)
2. Constructs JSON SyncSessionIn payload (excluding raw images & unmasked PII)
3. Computes SHA-256 body hash and canonical signature string
4. Signs canonical string with WebCrypto device private key
6. On HTTP 200 OK → marks session synced: true in Local Ledger
7. On Network Failure / HTTP 4xx/5xx → leaves synced: false for retry
• Reject revoked or suspended device status (403 DEVICE_REVOKED)
3. HQ BACKEND SERVICES & AUDIT HASH CHAIN (FASTAPI + SQLALCHEMY)
• Correlation ID Injection: X-Correlation-ID & X-Request-ID headers
• Early Payload Size Protection: Rejects requests > 1MB (/sync/session)
• Hardened Security Headers: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, X-Content-Type nosniff
• Privacy-Safe Observability: Logs latency & device ID; strictly excludes PII & keys
• Sliding-Window Rate Limiter: 300 requests/minute per client IP + device
• Nonce Replay Cache: Rejects duplicate request nonces within 10-minute window
Database Engine: SQLite (Local/Field Mode) | PostgreSQL (HQ Production)

Session persistence and SYNC_ACCEPTED audit write land inside one SQLAlchemy
transaction (db.flush() ➔ log(commit=False) ➔ db.commit()). Prevents un-audited sessions.
THREAD-SAFE AUDIT LOGGING: log(db, session_id, action, actor, detail, commit)
• Protected by threading.Lock (_AUDIT_LOCK) to prevent hash race conditions.
• Fetches last event_hash as prev_hash for current event.
• Computes new SHA-256 event_hash and appends to audit_log table.
• Sequentially recalculates and verifies hash chain from GENESIS to tip.
• Detects modified rows, deleted logs, or reordered audit events.
• Authentication: POST /admin/login issues Bearer token (30-minute TTL)
• Rate Limiting: 5 failed login attempts per minute locks client IP
• GET /admin/sessions: Paginated SQL query with filters (checkpoint, decision, band, q)
• GET /admin/sessions/{id}: Detailed session audit trail & history view
• GET /admin/audit/verify: Runs full cryptographic audit chain verification
• GET /admin/stats & /admin/analytics: SQL aggregation over screening metrics
• GET /admin/export: Generates operational compliance report JSON
